acceptanceCriteria: The applied config bytes are persisted locally alongside the digest, bounded and private
Startup on an invalid file with a persisted last-applied config runs on it with a loud warning and a non-OK status, or the feature is declined with a recorded reason
body: Follow-up to #1157 / V1-1852. ATR-V0-135 documents that a restart on an invalid config file leaves no dispatcher, because the ledger keeps only the applied config's digest and time, not its bytes. A supervisor restart loop therefore idles all work until someone fixes the file. Optional improvement asked in #1157.
title: Optional: persist the last applied dispatch config so a restart on an invalid file can keep running on it
